title: cost-optimization-autotune-batching-caching-quant-uecon-tooling
author: Elena Park
description: Motivation: reduce per-token unit cost for common workloads by providing safe defaults and automated tuning across batching, KV/prefix caching, and quantization profiles, plus visibility in unit-economics tooling. This PR implements an autotune flow that samples production-like traffic, evaluates latency/quality/cost tradeoffs, and recommends (and optionally applies) configuration changes. It includes: 1) new default profiles for batching and cache TTLs tuned by request histogram; 2) quantization profile registry and automatic compatibility checks for model variants; 3) unit-econ SDK additions and a dashboard ingestion hook; 4) an opt-in autotune controller that runs in staging and can generate upgrade proposals for Dedicated/Private deployments. See commits for details. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (ENG-4821) - [x] unit tests for autotune scoring and profile selection - [x] e2e smoke test for staging controller - [x] docs + migration notes - [x] dashboard metric feeds added Rollout plan: staged enablement (staging -> limited prod -> global) with automatic rollback on quality regressions. Backwards compatibility: new defaults are opt-in for legacy deployments; autosuggests are visible in console before apply.

review_comments: Marco Li: Nice work on separating scoring from execution. Two requests: expose sampling window length as a runtime flag and add a lower bound for cache TTLs to avoid excessive evictions.
Elena Park: Addressed in controller.py — sampling window is now configurable via AUTOTUNE_WINDOW_SECONDS and cache TTL lower bound set to 30s. Updated tests to validate bounds.
Priya Desai: Unit-econ ingestion looks good; can we add a small dashboard example for how to interpret the suggested delta_cost vs quality_loss?
Elena Park: Added example chart to docs and sample dashboard widget in console code.
merge_summary: Squashed 5 commits into main. Enabled staging controller manifest; config defaults added. No production flags flipped by default.
release_notes: Added autotune controller to sample workload and recommend batching/caching/quantization profiles. Added unit-econ SDK hooks and console UI for proposals. Autotune is staging-only by default and opt-in for production. See docs/autotune.md for migration and safety guidelines.
observability_changes: Added metrics: autotune.proposals.created, autotune.proposals.applied, autotune.scoring.latency_ms, uecon.delta_cost. Dashboard sample added to console.
rollback_plan:
Autotune proposals are applied only after manual or scheduled approval. Controller supports dry-run mode and will automatically halt proposals if quality regression > 0.5% or latency increase > 15%.
For emergency rollback, operators can revert to prior default_profiles.yaml and restart runtime; runbooks updated in docs.
notes: This PR is part of the ENG-4821 initiative (cost optimization automation). Follow-up PRs will add support for GPU-family specific quant profiles and Live Canary application flow for Dedicated customers. Staging rollout scheduled for 2026-02-22.
migration_instructions: 1) Review proposals in Console > Autotune. 2) Enable proposal apply for target deployment (opt-in). 3) Monitor uecon.delta_cost and quality dashboards for 24h. 4) Revert via Console or apply previous default_profiles.yaml if regressions observed.
qa_steps:
- Run integration-smoke in staging cluster
- Seed test traffic with distribution similar to production histogram
- Verify proposals appear in Console
- Apply one proposal to a canary service and validate latency/quality metrics
- Run unit-econ ingestion and confirm dashboard shows delta_cost entries
